soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3: oracle-recovery clause
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed distance to the union of lower-rank strata is undefined when that union is empty (including r0=0, and positive-delta cases with no lower-rank null); declare inf ∅=+∞ or restrict the clause to a nonempty lower-stratum union.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3: admissible-procedure scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform inference is assumed only for chosen implementations whose estimator, influence estimates, covariance estimator, multiplier, and simulation routine satisfy membership in A_adm; the DDD chart alone does not establish this.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform size, coverage, power approximation, and oracle recovery are conditional on (Pbullet,Abullet) belonging to A_adm, with primitive law membership in P_loc.
